notes: В §36 предлагается не умножать виды причинности, пока попытка обойтись одним не доведена до предела. Здесь описан методический принцип этого рассуждения, а не доказательство его успешности, универсальное правило науки или инструкция обработчику ToS.
preferred_label: Испытать одну причинность до её предела — метод JGB 36

applicability_conditions: The account concerns explanatory causality within the hypothetical inquiry in JGB 36.
The will-causality trial additionally depends on acknowledging will as causally effective.
semantic_content.method_account: Try whether one kind of causality can suffice before positing additional kinds, pursuing that trial to its limits without treating success as established.

semantic_scope.identity_criterion: Retain this subject while describing the one-causality trial and its limits in this passage; another inquiry procedure needs a distinct referent.
semantic_scope.scope_note: The methodological trial of one kind of causality in JGB 36, not every use of methodological economy.

variant_labels.value: Testing one causality to its limit — method in JGB 36
